title: gilia texana
intro: Gilia texana, commonly known as Texan gilia, is a flowering plant in the borage family. It is native to the southwestern United States and Mexico, where it grows in dry areas and grasslands. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Gilia texana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation.
